# Ezekiel 14 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-came to-me men from-[the]-elders-of Israel, and-they-sat before-me.

**2** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying:

**3** "Son-of man, these men have-set-up their-idols upon their-heart, and-the-stumbling-block-of their-iniquity they-have-put before their-face. Shall-I-be-inquired-of, yes-be-inquired-of, by-them?

**4** Therefore speak to-them and-say to-them, 'Thus says the-Lord YHWH: Any-man from-the-house-of Israel who-sets-up his-idols upon his-heart and-the-stumbling-block-of his-iniquity puts before his-face, and-comes to the-prophet — I, YHWH, will-answer-him in-it according-to the-multitude-of his-idols,

**5** in-order-to seize the-house-of Israel in-their-heart, [they] who have-turned-away from-upon-Me through-all their-idols.'

**6** Therefore say to-the-house-of Israel, 'Thus says the-Lord YHWH: Return! And-turn-back from-upon your-idols, and-from-upon all your-abominations turn your-faces.'

**7** For any-man from-the-house-of Israel and-from-the-sojourner who-sojourns in-Israel, and-he-separates-himself from-after-Me, and-sets-up his-idols upon his-heart, and-the-stumbling-block-of his-iniquity puts before his-face, and-comes to the-prophet to-inquire of-Me through-him — I, YHWH, will-answer-him by-Myself.

**8** And-I-will-set My-face against that man, and-I-will-make-him for-a-sign and-for-proverbs, and-I-will-cut-him-off from-the-midst-of My-people; and-you-shall-know that I [am] YHWH.

**9** And-the-prophet — if he-is-deceived and-speaks a-word, I, YHWH, have-deceived that prophet; and-I-will-stretch-out My-hand against-him and-destroy-him from-the-midst-of My-people Israel.

**10** And-they-shall-bear their-iniquity; like-the-iniquity-of the-inquirer, so-the-iniquity-of the-prophet shall-be,

**11** so-that the-house-of Israel may-no-longer stray from-after-Me, and-may-no-longer defile-themselves with-all their-transgressions; and-they-shall-be to-Me for-a-people and-I will-be to-them for-God," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**12** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying:

**13** "Son-of man, a-land — when it-sins against-Me by-acting-unfaithfully, and-I-stretch-out My-hand against-it, and-I-break for-it [the]-staff-of bread, and-I-send against-it famine, and-I-cut-off from-it human and-beast —

**14** and-these three men were in-its-midst — Noah, Daniel, and-Job — they by-their-righteousness would-deliver their-[own]-souls," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**15** "Even-if Noah, Daniel, and-Job were-in-the-land, they could-deliver neither son nor daughter — only their-own-souls by-their-righteousness," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**16** "Even-if Noah, Daniel, and-Job were-in-the-land, they could-deliver neither son nor daughter — only their-own-souls by-their-righteousness," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**17** "Even-if Noah, Daniel, and-Job were-in-the-land, they could-deliver neither son nor daughter — only their-own-souls by-their-righteousness," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**18** "Even-if Noah, Daniel, and-Job were-in-the-land, they could-deliver neither son nor daughter — only their-own-souls by-their-righteousness," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**19** "Even-if Noah, Daniel, and-Job were-in-the-land, they could-deliver neither son nor daughter — only their-own-souls by-their-righteousness," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**20** "Even-if Noah, Daniel, and-Job were-in-the-land, they could-deliver neither son nor daughter — only their-own-souls by-their-righteousness," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**21** For thus says the-Lord YHWH: "How-much-more when My-four judgments — evil — sword and-famine and-evil-beast and-pestilence — I-send against Jerusalem, to-cut-off from-it human and-beast!

**22** And-behold — there-shall-be-left in-it an-escaped-remnant, [who]-are-brought-out, sons and-daughters. Behold-them going-out to-you, and-you-shall-see their-way and-their-deeds, and-you-shall-be-comforted concerning the-evil which I-brought upon Jerusalem — all which I-brought upon-it.

**23** And-they-shall-comfort-you when you-see their-way and-their-deeds; and-you-shall-know that not without-cause I-did all which I-did in-it," declares the-Lord YHWH.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **14:3**: Gilluleihem el-libbam — 'their idols upon their heart.' The idols are internalized — not just external statues but heart-allegiances. YHWH refuses consultation from those whose hearts are already committed elsewhere.

- **14:14**: Noach, Daniel, ve-Iyov — three legendary righteous figures. The 'Daniel' here may be the ancient Danel of Ugaritic legend rather than the biblical Daniel, who would be Ezekiel's contemporary.

- **14:9**: Va-ani YHWH pittiti — 'I, YHWH, have deceived that prophet.' Difficult theology: YHWH takes responsibility for the deception of false prophets as a form of judgment (cf. 1 Kgs 22:19-23).

— EMET
